info.description: Public Contact API: the form POST automatically sends its own notification; no dispatch command is required. HTTP 200 is persisted provider acceptance, not inbox delivery. HTTP 202 means safely stored and pending automatic retry. Keys stay server-side. Recipient is fixed to ramtin.babaei2002@gmail.com. Local rate limit defaults to 100/hour after setup; production defaults to 5. Preserve the same body and idempotency key when retrying.
